species.name: Afanc

dex.text: A lake monster that is mostly teeth, tail and reputation. The valley calls it a beast, but the lake says it is just busy building dams.
dex.fact: Beavers were hunted out of Britain centuries ago and have since been reintroduced, so the Afanc may be a folk memory of them.

species.real: A beaver's front teeth are orange because the enamel is laced with iron, which makes it tougher. Handy, when your whole career is chewing through trees.

dex.text: Builds a dam overnight, flooding a field, and seems to think the field was improved. Hard to argue, from a water-company point of view.
dex.fact: Beaver dams slow rivers and hold water back, and trials in England have found they can reduce flooding downstream.
